name: McCole 2

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a paved driveway that leads from the street to the front of the primary structure. The driveway offers space for vehicle approach and parking near the building. Vehicle tracks can also be observed around the perimeter of the residence. Open lawn and grassy areas surround the structure and provide space for movement. Mature trees are present on portions of the property. Fencing encloses much of the perimeter. Outdoor equipment and materials are present in the yard. Neighboring residences are present in the surrounding area.
